about.title: About Stitch
about.intro: Stitch is a hackathon decision-support demo. A Brain calls five organs and stitches their outputs into one briefing in which every claim links to the organ output it came from.
about.notOperational: Stitch is not an operational warning system. It has not been validated for operational use. Always follow official warnings.
about.honest.eyes: Eyes: the Sindh, Aug 2022 scene is a demo scene. The flood model is validated on the Sen1Floods11 test split only, not on Sindh.
about.honest.oracle: Oracle: river numbers are modeled GloFAS discharge read through Open-Meteo. They are model output, not instrument readings.
about.honest.library: Library: answers quote documents with page numbers, or the Library refuses. A refusal is a normal result.
about.honest.ledger: Ledger: the allocation comes from an optimizer over demo inputs; shadow prices come from its linear relaxation.
about.honest.voice: Voice: speech uses a hosted text-to-speech service. Briefing text is sent to it only after you agree.
